meta.source: design-inputs/game-assets/kenney_shape-characters /PNG/Double (Kenney Shape Characters 1.0, CC0; note the trailing space in the folder name)
meta.unit: Double-resolution source pixels. A head body is 160 x 160.

derivations.body_p1_orange_derived: DERIVED, NOT SOURCE ART (APPROVED P1 body, Option C): yellow_body_circle.png with hue rotated -13 degrees (about 40 -> 27 degrees), saturation, value and alpha unchanged. The owner approved it as the P1 body; it is wired into slot 0. The Kenney source file is unchanged.
derivations.halo_circle: halo mask for circle: body alpha, 4 px dilation, 7 px Gaussian feather, white; tinted at runtime
derivations.shadow_circle: ground shadow mask for circle: body alpha blurred 4 px, white; tinted and offset at runtime
derivations.halo_square: halo mask for square: body alpha, 4 px dilation, 7 px Gaussian feather, white; tinted at runtime
derivations.shadow_square: ground shadow mask for square: body alpha blurred 4 px, white; tinted and offset at runtime
derivations.halo_diamond: halo mask for diamond: body alpha, 4 px dilation, 7 px Gaussian feather, white; tinted at runtime
derivations.shadow_diamond: ground shadow mask for diamond: body alpha blurred 4 px, white; tinted and offset at runtime
derivations.halo_squircle: halo mask for squircle: body alpha, 4 px dilation, 7 px Gaussian feather, white; tinted at runtime
derivations.shadow_squircle: ground shadow mask for squircle: body alpha blurred 4 px, white; tinted and offset at runtime
derivations.eye_sclera: facial_part_eye_open.png: outer silhouette (alpha) filled white where the baked pupil is, so a pupil can move
derivations.eye_pupil: facial_part_eye_open.png: ink pixels only (white-to-ink antialias becomes alpha), same 40x40 canvas so it is concentric with eye_sclera
derivations.mouth_dot: eye_pupil trimmed to its ink disc. Scaled to an oval at runtime: the dark OPEN-MOUTH oval of the release scream, and the small alarmed oval of the fear face (the pack has no standalone oval mouth)
derivations.mouth_open_half: lower half of the eye_pupil ink disc (flat top, round bottom), widened at runtime into the open laughing mouth of the winner face (the pack has no wide open-smile mouth)
derivations.eye_x: face_j.png: the left X-eye connected component, cropped (right X is the same pixels)
derivations.brow_lift: face_j.png: the left slim brow component (inner end higher), cropped; the right brow is its mirror
derivations.brow_heavy: face_i.png: the left heavy brow component (inner end higher), cropped; flipped vertically at runtime it is the tense inward-slanted brow
derivations.mouth_flat: NO flat neutral mouth exists in the pack. facial_part_eyebrow_a.png (a level flat dark bar with round ends) resampled to 30 x 8 px, the stroke weight of facial_part_mouth_happy.png
derivations.mouth_grin: NO broader grin exists in the pack. facial_part_mouth_happy.png scaled uniformly x1.45 (a wider, deeper curve with a heavier stroke)
derivations.ghost_eye_brow: face_f.png: the left angry-brow + narrowed-eye unit (x 0..53, y 0..45; the right unit is its exact mirror), mouth excluded
